Title: EVT-OP-031: Uniform rates for Good–Turing under regularly varying frequencies
Labels: open-problem, area:statistics, type:research, difficulty:hard, status:research

**Status in the survey:** Open in the source, though the survey notes that the source's own proposition suggests uniform rates fail. Adjacent to extreme value theory, not core.

## Source and quote
Ayed, Battiston, Camerlenghi and Favaro, arXiv:1806.09712:

> An open problem is to extend Proposition 2.2 to the uniform case, when considering the supremum of the risk over all $P\in\mathcal{P}_{RV_{\alpha}}$

The quote was extracted from the source text, with symbols flattened; check it against the published version before citing.

## Why it matters
Estimating missing mass under heavy-tailed frequencies.

## What the library already has
Regular variation only.

## What is missing
Karlin occupancy, missing mass and minimax theory.
